reviews.body: This kit saved me so much time. Really well organized and the components just work out of the box.
Honestly one of the best UI kits I've bought. The dark mode theme is particularly good.
Great components, I just wish there were more mobile-specific patterns included.
Used this on three client projects now. Worth every penny.
Clean, consistent, and the accessibility notes are a huge bonus for our team.
Very useful library. Documentation could be more detailed but the components themselves are excellent.
Purchased for my whole design team. Everyone loves it especially the color token system.
The Sketch version works flawlessly. Finally a kit that respects both tool users.
Good quality overall. A few icons were missing from the set but otherwise no complaints.
Really comprehensive. I especially like that it covers both Figma and Sketch without compromise.
Great buy! Used it for a redesign project and the client was very happy.
Highly recommended for any designer who works on complex products. The component hierarchy makes sense.
